purpose: filegroup(output_group = ...) (rules/filegroup/Filegroup.java:48-146, FilegroupRule.java:41-49): an output group named with OutputGroupInfo.INTERNAL_SUFFIX (`_INTERNAL_`) is the attribute error `in output_group attribute of filegroup rule L: Output group NAME is not permitted for reference in filegroups.`; a non-empty one makes the files to build getArtifactsForOutputGroup — a NestedSetBuilder.stableOrder() with each `srcs` prerequisite's OutputGroupInfo.get(dep).getOutputGroup(NAME) added transitively (a source file has no OutputGroupInfo, an output file only its generating rule's `_validation` group (OutputFileConfiguredTarget.java:109-118), a native rule its framework groups, an alias its actual's) — and so the single-file executable and the first part of the data runfiles; the default runfiles and the `srcs`/`data` runfiles are unchanged; `output_group` is configurable. Also RuleConfiguredTargetBuilder.collectTransitiveValidationOutputGroups over an output-file prerequisite of a native rule (its generating rule's `_validation` group). Motivation: `build --nobuild //src/ts/...` on ~/code stopped at `//src/ts/packages/ws-api:ws_api_runfiles: filegroup accepted at load time but not analyzed by the native profile: attribute 'output_group' = "runfiles"` (aspect_rules_js 2.9.2 js_run_binary's `<name>_runfiles` filegroup over a js_library of the tool, js/private/js_run_binary.bzl:383-404).

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (genuine --show_result lines, bazel-bin = bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin; native LABEL<TAB>PATH lines below the action output root) as [mode, contents].
comparison (tests/filegroup_output_group: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal in order; a failing case's genuine message (or the recorded part of it) (the `Error in <callable>: ` / `Error: ` Starlark text, else the rule error following an empty `in KIND rule L: ` line, else the first ERROR message) is contained in native stderr; built top-level outputs (path below bazel-out -> [mode, contents]) equal; a `test` case's stdout (the test summary, ` in N.Ns` run times as ` in <T>s`) equal; a successful `run` case's stdout (the program's output) equal; a `query` case's stdout equal; the recorded outputs' existence after the command equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
genuine_key_findings: files = the group's files in srcs order, each once (fg_two [g1.extra, g1.extra2, g2.extra, g2.extra2], fg_shared [g1.own, common.txt, g2.own]); a list-valued group keeps its order; a single file is the executable (fg_single g1.sh, fg_src s.txt, fg_validation g1.valid); an absent group, an empty one and `default` give no files; the srcs' default runfiles stay the default runfiles, the data runfiles are the files then the srcs' data runfiles (fg_mixed adds gen_rule.txt).

Each member keeps its own depset layout in the stable-order set: a topological group [t1, t2, t3] (to_list) gives [t3, t2, t1] (walked unreversed), preorder [t1, t2, t3], postorder [t2, t3, t1]; two topological groups [g1.t3, g1.t2, g1.t1, g2.t3, g2.t2, g2.t1]; top-level results list the same order.

Source files, output files (`extra`), native filegroups and genrules contribute nothing; an alias forwards its actual's group. `_validation`: a rule's group, an output file's (its generating rule's; default runfiles []), a native filegroup's propagated one; every filegroup over g1 or its output file has OutputGroupInfo fields [_hidden_top_level_INTERNAL_, _validation] (lib_runfiles: [_hidden_top_level_INTERNAL_]).

A select() in output_group resolves per configuration (`--define=mode=pre` gives the preorder group); a filegroup over an output-group filegroup takes its files; js_run_binary's shape: the `runfiles` group of a js_library over a tool with data is [l.js, tool, t.txt], the genrule's $(SRCS) in that order and $(locations) sorted, built as action inputs; `run` of a binary with such filegroups in data stages their files and runfiles.

`_hidden_top_level_INTERNAL_` and `x_INTERNAL_` are `in output_group attribute of filegroup rule //pkg:fg_hidden: Output group _hidden_top_level_INTERNAL_ is not permitted for reference in filegroups.` (analysis error, exit 1).

A filegroup over an output file builds its generating rule's validation action (bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/pkg/g1.valid exists after `build //pkg:fg_out_file`); before this change the native rule did not propagate it.
known_divergences: Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH`, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`), no INFO lines; native result lines of source files are not compared (Bazel prints `up-to-date (nothing to build)`).
Native is passed --experimental-builtin-modules in every case (as in the other paired fixtures).
